items.title: OpenAI and Apple announce ChatGPT integration
items.summaryZh: 宣布将 ChatGPT 接入 Siri 与系统写作工具。
items.summary: OpenAI and Apple announced a partnership bringing ChatGPT capabilities to Siri and systemwide Writing Tools across Apple devices.

items.title: Apple ships ChatGPT support in Apple Intelligence
items.summaryZh: 合作进入正式上线阶段：Siri 和 Writing Tools 可调用 ChatGPT。
items.summary: Apple launched ChatGPT integration in Siri and Writing Tools alongside its December Apple Intelligence update for supported devices.

items.title: Apple brings ChatGPT-powered writing to Vision Pro
items.summaryZh: 同一合作扩展到 Vision Pro；可与前两条择优保留。
items.summary: Apple expanded Apple Intelligence to Vision Pro, including ChatGPT-powered composition in Writing Tools and additional creative features.

items.title: Granola MCP connects meeting notes to ChatGPT and Claude
items.summaryZh: Granola 自有 MCP 连接器将会议上下文带入 ChatGPT、Claude 和 Cursor。
items.summary: Granola launched an MCP connector letting ChatGPT and Claude retrieve meeting notes and use conversation context across workflows.
items.dateNote: 原始日期由 article:published_time 和 datePublished 一致确认；网页仅显示 February 4。

items.title: Plaud connects recordings and notes to ChatGPT and Claude
items.summaryZh: 通过 MCP 接入录音、转写与摘要；属于产品兼容整合，不等于双方战略合作。
items.summary: Plaud introduced MCP integrations that let ChatGPT and Claude access recordings, transcripts and summaries for connected work.
items.dateNote: datePublished 为 2026-07-29；dateModified 与页面当前显示为 2026-10-19。导入用原始发布日期。原文明确不代表 OpenAI/Anthropic 背书或关联。

items.title: Plaud launches a native Salesforce integration
items.summaryZh: 把现场对话摘要及文件链接同步到 Salesforce 的联系人、商机和账户记录。
items.summary: Plaud launched a Salesforce integration that turns captured conversations into CRM records, summaries and linked meeting intelligence.
items.dateNote: 采用原文显示的发布日期；与 Plaud MCP 是不同产品整合。

items.title: Plaud builds its AI infrastructure on Microsoft Azure
items.summaryZh: Microsoft 客户案例确认 Plaud 使用 Azure 语音、模型推理及安全服务。
items.summary: Microsoft documented how Plaud uses Azure services for speech processing, model inference and content safety across its infrastructure.
items.dateNote: 日期为客户案例发表日，不是双方合同签署日。Azure OpenAI 是经 Microsoft 提供的模型服务，不另推断直接战略协议。

items.title: Samsung launches Perplexity on its TVs
items.summaryZh: Perplexity TV App 正式上线，提供大屏问答入口。
items.summary: Samsung launched the Perplexity TV App, adding conversational search to compatible televisions and its Vision AI Companion experience.

items.title: Samsung showcases Gemini and Perplexity agents on Galaxy S26
items.summaryZh: MWC 官方发布确认 Galaxy 的多智能体入口包含 Gemini 与 Perplexity。
items.summary: Samsung demonstrated Galaxy S26 agent experiences with Gemini and Perplexity, supporting search and coordinated actions across apps.
items.dateNote: 这是 MWC 展示文章日期，不写成首次签约日。只连接 Samsung–Google 与 Samsung–Perplexity，不推断 Google–Perplexity 合作。

items.title: Samsung and Google Cloud announce a multiyear AI partnership
items.summaryZh: 将 Google Cloud 的 Gemini 与 Imagen 能力带入 Galaxy S24。
items.summary: Samsung and Google Cloud announced a multiyear partnership bringing Gemini and Imagen capabilities to the Galaxy S24 series.
items.dateNote: 采用此新加坡官方新闻页的 2024-01-18 日期；其他地区时区可能显示前一天。

items.title: HP previews AI PCs powered by NVIDIA RTX Spark
items.summaryZh: HP 官方发布 NVIDIA RTX Spark 平台 PC，覆盖本地 AI 与创作。
items.summary: HP previewed PCs powered by NVIDIA RTX Spark, targeting local AI workflows, content creation and high-performance Windows experiences.

items.title: Dell expands the Dell AI Factory with NVIDIA
items.summaryZh: 双方扩展从 AI 工作站到数据中心的联合解决方案。
items.summary: Dell expanded its AI Factory collaboration with NVIDIA, adding workstations, infrastructure and services for enterprise AI deployment.

items.title: Perplexity and AWS collaborate on Enterprise Pro
items.summaryZh: 明确的联合销售、活动及市场合作；关系对象是 AWS 云业务。
items.summary: Perplexity announced an AWS collaboration covering Enterprise Pro distribution, joint events, co-selling and co-marketing for business customers.
items.dateNote: 原始新闻为 2024-07-09。Amazon 节点在此代表 AWS，不能推断 Amazon 所有业务都与 Perplexity 合作。

items.title: Anthropic expands its AWS training partnership
items.summaryZh: Amazon 增资，AWS 成为主要云与训练伙伴；是协议扩大，不是单纯模型提及。
items.summary: Anthropic expanded its AWS partnership with additional Amazon investment and collaboration on Trainium hardware, model training and deployment.

items.title: Anthropic expands its Google and Broadcom compute agreement
items.summaryZh: 新增多吉瓦 TPU 计算资源协议，计划从 2027 年开始上线。
items.summary: Anthropic signed an expanded Google and Broadcom agreement for next-generation TPU capacity expected to become available starting in 2027.
items.dateNote: 只连接 Anthropic–Google 与 Anthropic–Broadcom；这篇文章没有单独证明 Google–Broadcom 新签了另一份协议。

items.title: Oura and Dexcom announce a strategic partnership
items.summaryZh: 结合戒指生理数据与血糖数据，并开展联合营销；Dexcom 同时投资 Oura。
items.summary: Oura and Dexcom announced data integration and co-marketing plans, alongside a strategic Dexcom investment in Oura funding.

items.title: Oura launches metabolic health with Dexcom Stelo integration
items.summaryZh: 此前宣布的合作进入产品落地阶段，可在 Oura 中查看 Stelo 血糖数据。
items.summary: Oura launched metabolic health features with Dexcom Stelo integration, combining glucose measurements with sleep, stress and activity insights.

items.title: Oura expands distribution through Amazon
items.summaryZh: Oura 官方宣布进入 Amazon 渠道销售；是渠道合作，不是模型或数据合作。
items.summary: Oura announced availability through Amazon, expanding retail access to its rings and sizing kits for customers in the United States.
items.dateNote: 原始日期 2024-03-07；文章后来补充英国渠道信息，不将更新内容误标为初始事件。

items.title: Microsoft and OpenAI amend their partnership agreement
items.summaryZh: 双方调整合作条款；可与早期协议放在同一关系的时间线中。
items.summary: Microsoft and OpenAI announced an amended agreement intended to simplify their partnership and provide greater flexibility for both companies.

items.title: OpenAI and Amazon announce a strategic partnership
items.summaryZh: 新增多年度战略合作，覆盖企业 AI、基础设施及产品服务。
items.summary: OpenAI and Amazon announced a multiyear strategic partnership spanning enterprise AI, infrastructure and new products for business customers.
